blurb: Atlantic Aviation Boca Raton offers FBO services including hangar space, customs, concierge, Hertz rental, Wi-Fi, pilot's lounge, conference room, and trip planning. Located 2 miles from Boca Raton and 45 minutes from Miami, it serves as a convenient airport facility with 24-hour operations. The FBO is undergoing terminal renovation with a temporary facility in use until mid-2026.
